1. Larger values (ranks near/above U, so the classification clamping is exercised).
2. pifo_bytes very small (forcing evictions).
3. fifo_bytes very small (forcing rejections).
4. Single range (R=1).
5. Larger sample periods (no automatic samples) and sample_period=1 (automatic samples on every admission).
6. Multiple load balancers and banks.
7. Restores of names saved earlier (out-of-order restores).
8. Cancels of packets in the PIFO stage.
